items.information: ##Português: **Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com o delegado (fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org)**. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Caso o limite de 50 competidores não seja atingido, estaremos aceitando inscrições no local pelo preço de R$30, por ordem de chegada. ##English: **Attention:** This competition will have a limit of competitors. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the delegate (fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org)**. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. If the competitor limit of 50 has not been reached, we'll be accepting on the spot registrations for the price of R$30, in order of arrival.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdCtEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--079c7aadbdf46eaf6acabe4fc3f1b4f76e4b4548/image.png) Bienvenue au Moroccan Nationals 2024. Cet été, la ville de Casablanca accueillera la toute première édition des championnats nationaux marocains, un événement historique pour notre communauté de speedcubing. Ce tournoi offrira aux participants l'opportunité de se mesurer aux meilleurs et de tenter de décrocher le titre prestigieux de "Champion National" dans chaque catégorie. Welcome to the Moroccan Nationals 2024. This summer, the city of Casablanca will host the very first edition of the Moroccan National Championships, a historic event for our speedcubing community. This tournament provides participants with the opportunity to compete against the best and strive for the prestigious title of "National Champion" in each category. We look forward to seeing you in Casablanca for a thrilling competition and to share our passion for speedcubing. Good luck to all participants! [Moroccan Cube Association](https://www.fb.me/MoroccanCubeAssociation)

items.information: This is the 12th WCA competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The competition is open to all persons from all countries. There will be certificates and medals for all competitors in top 3 of an event. ================ Ovo je 12. WCA takmičenje u Bosni i Hercegovini. Takmičenje je otvoreno za sve osobe iz svih zemalja. Za sve takmičare u prva 3 mjesta biće dodeljeni sertifikati i medalje.
